w: As a celebration to Father's Day, a few youths from London offered gifts before the murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj. Swamishri, pointing to Harikrishna Maharaj, said, "This is your real Father. Spiritual Father. Atma's Father. Never forget Him. Say the rosary, perform puja and offer devotion to Him everyday. You should bow down daily to your father and always remember this Father. In all your activities say 'Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan...' He is your Atma's Father while the one at home is the father of your body..."
At 10.30 am the Indian Ambassador for Portugal, Shri Bhatnagar came for Swamishri's darshan.

Bernadino meeting Swamishri, formerly a retarded, deaf and dumb boy, was first blessed by Swamishri in 1984 in Lisbon and again in 1988. Ever since then his growth became normal and he can now talk and hear.
At 6.45 pm the Mayor of Lisbon, Mr. Juan Soares, welcomed Swamishri with a bouquet in an assembly of 1700 people.
Swamishri departed from Kolkata at 8.52 pm and arrived in Nagpur at 10.20pm.
Anything acquired with dharma and God in the forefront will give you peace and happiness.
There are problems, problems and problems because we have lost our morals, dharma and life's foundation..
Swamishri instructed a sadhu to acquire medicines from pharmaceutical companies for the honorary dispensaries running at our mandir in Sankari, Tithal (Kosamba) and Navsari.
The sadhu replied, "I will make the effort and though your blessings it will all work out well."
Swamishri replied, "You believe in the efficacy of blessings."

The sadhu said, " I believe that any task done intelligently, with due planning and with your blessings will work out successfully. However, there are people who believe God to be the all-doer but do not make any efforts!"

Swamishri added on a note of consent, "You are right. Firstly, one should endeavor intelligently. Then if the work is successfully done, believe God to be the doer, and if there is no success then still He is the doer,"
The sadhu replied, "I believe in that."

Swamishri finally revealed, "That's right. Your belief is true. I too live according to that belief. One put in a hundred percent effort in whatever one does. Then by believing God to be the all-doer one experiences peace of mind. Otherwise, there would be no end to worries!"
Swamishri's conviction and faith in Bhagwan Swaminarayan's all-doership is evident through his blissful, relaxed and unperturbed life.
During the Bal-Kishore camp held in the presence of Swamishri, a kishore asked Swamishri, "Swami, you are very happy and always rejoicing in eternal joy. Is this true?"

Swamishri: "I am happy because I've met God and the guru. When the soul attains God, it experiences joy. Because God is the source of all joy, from Him comes all joy and happiness. And having attained that joy one does not desire for worldly happiness!"
Then pointing to a boy who had played an unhappy son of a rich man in a short drama called "A happy man's clothes", the kishore asked Swamishri whether he would be give him his clothes.

Swamishri replied pointing to his upper clothe ('gatariyu'), "If I were to give him this (that is if he were to become a sadhu) he would become happy. There would be no troubles or miseries for him. Secondly, I have this rosary. If he starts saying the rosary, then he would become happy. We should wear the 'clothes' of God, 'clothes' of knowledge, bhakti and 'clothes' of the guru, then there will be no miseries.

"Yogiji Maharaj used to say that this rosary is an 'atom bomb'. It will make everyone happy in the world. Hence, if one has the rosary, then there will be happiness in life ... When one realizes the knowledge of God, then one will become happy. When one becomes focused on God and realizes Him, then one does not desire for mundane happiness."
For eternal happiness, Swamishri emphasized the need for focussing ourselves on God.
If we live with the understanding that God is all-doer then we will remain relaxed and happy in all times and situations.

In the evening satsang assembly members of the bal mandal presented narrations of incidents and recitations of Swamini Vato, Vachanamrut and Bhagvad Gita on the subject of happiness. Thereafter they enacted a story from Yogiji Maharaj's parable, 'Two Works I have Done'. The message of the story was that the disciple should obey the guru. Finally Swamishri addressed the assembly, "The ideal guru-disciple relationship was exemplified by Gunatitanand Swami and Bhagatji Maharaj. The guru (Gunatitanand Swami) was pure for he desired for nothing mundane and discoursed to redeem people. The disciple (Bhagatji Maharaj) pleased the guru and obeyed his words immediately..."
The Mayor of the City of Hawaiian Gardens, Leonard Chaidaz, presented a proclamation and a memento to honor Swamishri.

w: Dr Bhagirath Katbamna showed Swamishri a capsule and explained, “This is our technology. This transparent capsule has two very tiny cameras. When the patient swallows it the cameras take pictures of the internal organs as it travels along. The photos are received through an external receiver. We come to know the exact state of the person’s intestines and other body parts. So, this is our technology. Can you show us your technology?” Swamishri instantly responded, “Our technology is to become aksharrup and offer devotion to God. You have to consolidate the knowledge that you are atma, akshar and brahman. You are not Katbamna. You do not have any relatives and parents. When you realize that you are akshar or atmarup then you will transcend maya.” Swamishri revealed the highest spiritual technology of becoming aksharrup or atmarup.
